instruction: Tidy up my desk: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder, the mug goes on the blue coaster, notebooks go on the orange tray, and crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket. Some things are already where they belong; leave them there.

attempts.code:
# Grasp green_pen across short axis, move above magenta_holder, reorient/drop upright
grasp_elongated_object("green_pen", min_height=0.012)

obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# Position above holder and orient upright / drop into holder
target_z = hz + rim_h + 0.08
reorient_held_object_upright(hx, hy, target_z)
drop_into_container_v2("green_pen", "magenta_holder", safe_z_offset=rim_h + 0.06)

go_home()
check("green_pen", "magenta_holder")

# Grasp mug higher near its rim (height ~0.058-0.065) to avoid gripper collision
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_mug")
# Filter or choose candidate with height near 0.058 or modify candidate height
chosen = None
for c in candidates:
    if c.get("height", 0) > 0.05:
        chosen = c
        break
if chosen is None and len(candidates) > 0:
    chosen = dict(candidates[0])
    chosen["height"] = 0.058

grasp(chosen)

obs = observe()
zone = obs["zones"]["blue_coaster"]
cx, cy = zone["center"][0], zone["center"][1]
rim_h = zone.get("rim_height", 0.0)

clear_h = max(0.18, rim_h + 0.12)
place_at_position(cx, cy, clear_height=clear_h, retreat_height=0.12)
go_home()
check("yellow_mug", "blue_coaster")
